title: Algebra for All mediation
content: Figure 9.10 models classroom Environment as a mediator between Algebra for All and Learning while retaining a direct policy-to-learning path. Hong reports a roughly +2.7 point direct effect and a -2.3 point indirect effect through environment, for a modest net +0.4 point effect. These are aggregate reported effects, not edge coefficients.

variables.name: Algebra for All
variables.content: The 1997 policy requiring all ninth graders to take college-preparatory algebra.

variables.name: Environment
variables.content: The classroom environment, measured by the median skill level of the students in the classroom.

variables.name: Learning
variables.content: The students' learning outcome, represented by test scores in the adjacent analysis.
